name: 170mm DC Exhaust Fan — 24W
function: Pulls air through the complete cooling system and delivers the conditioned air into the room.
working: When powered, the fan rotates and creates airflow through the cooling pad, Venturi section, and silica-gel plates.
role: Provides the final airflow and helps overcome the resistance created by the cooling pad and silica-gel cassettes.

name: Tower Fan — 90mm × 40mm

attributes.label: Rated voltage
attributes.value: Not specified in the concept note

function: Pushes cooled air toward the Venturi section.
working: The fan rotates and creates a continuous airflow from the cooling-pad section toward the Venturi channel.
role: Maintains airflow through the system and works together with the exhaust fan to overcome flow resistance.

name: Flat Cylindrical DC Motor — 12V
working: When 12V DC is supplied, the motor converts electrical energy into rotational mechanical energy, which rotates the fan and pushes air through the system.
role: It provides the airflow required to move the cooled, humid air toward the Venturi section and silica-gel plates.

name: Water Pump — 12V, 3.8W
function: Pumps water from the reservoir to the cooling pad.
working: The pump draws water from the tank and pushes it through a water pipe to the top of the cooling pad, keeping the pad continuously wet.
role: Supplies the water required for evaporative cooling.

name: Cooling Pad
function: Cools the incoming hot air through evaporation.
working: Water spreads over the pad, and when hot air passes through it, some water evaporates and absorbs heat from the air.
role: Acts as the primary cooling stage and converts hot outside air into cool but humid air.

name: Silica Gel Plates — 90 × 90 × 20mm
function: Removes excess moisture from the cooled air.
working: Cool, humid air passes through the silica-gel plates, and the silica gel adsorbs water vapour from the air.
role: Reduces the humidity produced by the evaporative cooling process, providing cooler and drier air.

name: Water Reservoir — 0.5L
function: Stores water required for evaporative cooling.
working: The stored water is drawn by the 12V pump and supplied continuously to the cooling pad.
role: Provides the water supply for the evaporative cooling process.

name: Water Pipe
function: Carries water from the pump to the cooling pad.
working: The 12V pump forces water through the pipe toward the top of the cooling pad, allowing the water to spread over the pad.
role: Ensures continuous water delivery to maintain the wet surface required for evaporation.

name: Venturi Channel

attributes.label: Design
attributes.value: Converging channel with a throat width of approximately 130mm

function: Increases the velocity of the airflow.
working: As the cross-sectional area of the channel decreases, air velocity increases according to the continuity equation, A₁V₁ = A₂V₂.
role: Creates a faster, focused airflow through the silica-gel plates, improving air–desiccant contact and moisture absorption.

name: Fiber Outer Body — 170 × 170 × 480mm
function: Provides the main structural enclosure for the system.
working: It houses and supports the internal components while providing a defined path for the airflow.
role: Forms the main body of the prototype and incorporates the Venturi section.

name: Silica Gel Regeneration System
function: Restores the moisture-absorbing capacity of saturated silica gel.
working: When saturated, the removable silica-gel cassette is taken out and placed under direct sunlight. Solar heat drives the absorbed moisture out of the silica gel.
role: Allows the silica gel to be reused without additional electrical energy for regeneration.
